errors.shortDescription: Unable to get the MeshSync resource
probableCause: The MeshSync custom resource was deleted, or operator RBAC denies get/list/watch on meshsyncs
suggestedRemediation: Confirm the MeshSync CR exists and that the operator's ClusterRole grants get/list/watch on meshsyncs.meshery.io

errors.shortDescription: Unable to create the MeshSync workload
probableCause: The MeshSync Deployment or its owned objects could not be created
suggestedRemediation: Check the operator RBAC for deployments and inspect the events in the MeshSync namespace

errors.shortDescription: MeshSync reconciliation failed
probableCause: Broker configuration, workload deployment, or the health check failed for MeshSync
suggestedRemediation: Check the MeshSync status conditions and the operator logs for the failing reconcile step

errors.shortDescription: Unable to get the Broker resource
probableCause: The Broker custom resource was deleted, or operator RBAC denies get/list/watch on brokers
suggestedRemediation: Confirm the Broker CR exists and that the operator's ClusterRole grants get/list/watch on brokers.meshery.io

errors.shortDescription: Unable to create the Broker workload
probableCause: The NATS StatefulSet, Service, or ConfigMaps could not be created
suggestedRemediation: Check the operator RBAC and inspect the events on the owned objects in the broker namespace

errors.shortDescription: Broker reconciliation failed
probableCause: The NATS StatefulSet, Service, or ConfigMaps could not be created or updated
suggestedRemediation: Check the operator RBAC and inspect the events on the owned objects in the broker namespace

errors.shortDescription: Custom resource reconciliation failed
probableCause: A reconcile step failed for the custom resource
suggestedRemediation: Check the operator logs for the underlying cause; the controller will requeue and retry

errors.shortDescription: Unable to delete the MeshSync workload
probableCause: Owned MeshSync objects could not be deleted during finalization
suggestedRemediation: Inspect the MeshSync finalizers and confirm the operator RBAC grants delete on deployments

errors.shortDescription: Unable to delete the Broker workload
probableCause: Owned broker objects could not be deleted during finalization
suggestedRemediation: Inspect the Broker finalizers and confirm the operator RBAC grants delete on statefulsets, services, and configmaps

errors.shortDescription: Workload health check failed
probableCause: The StatefulSet or Deployment has not reached its desired ReadyReplicas
suggestedRemediation: Inspect the pod status and events for the workload; the controller will requeue and retry

errors.shortDescription: Unable to derive the broker endpoint
probableCause: The broker Service has no reachable internal or external address yet
suggestedRemediation: Verify the broker Service exists and has assigned ports and an address; LoadBalancer addresses may still be pending

errors.shortDescription: Unable to update the resource
probableCause: A status patch or resource update conflicted or was rejected by the API server
suggestedRemediation: Check for concurrent writers and confirm the operator RBAC grants update on the resource and its status; the controller will retry

errors.shortDescription: Unable to get a broker-owned resource
probableCause: The broker StatefulSet, Service, or ConfigMap lookup failed
suggestedRemediation: Check the operator RBAC and confirm the resource exists in the broker namespace

errors.shortDescription: Broker replicas are not ready
probableCause: The NATS StatefulSet has not reached its desired ReadyReplicas
suggestedRemediation: Inspect the StatefulSet pod status and events; the controller will requeue and retry

errors.shortDescription: A broker readiness condition is false
probableCause: A required status condition on the broker workload reports False
suggestedRemediation: Inspect the broker status conditions for the reported reason

errors.shortDescription: Unable to get the broker endpoint
probableCause: The broker Service is not yet reachable or has no assigned address
suggestedRemediation: Verify the broker Service and its ports; a pending LoadBalancer address resolves on a later reconcile

errors.shortDescription: Unable to marshal the resource
probableCause: The custom resource could not be serialized for a status patch
suggestedRemediation: This indicates a defect in the status builder; please report it with the operator logs

errors.shortDescription: Unable to get a MeshSync-owned resource
probableCause: The MeshSync Deployment lookup failed
suggestedRemediation: Check the operator RBAC and confirm the Deployment exists in the MeshSync namespace

errors.shortDescription: MeshSync replicas are not ready
probableCause: The MeshSync Deployment has not reached its desired ReadyReplicas
suggestedRemediation: Inspect the Deployment pod status and events; the controller will requeue and retry

errors.shortDescription: A MeshSync readiness condition is false
probableCause: A required status condition on the MeshSync workload reports False
suggestedRemediation: Inspect the MeshSync status conditions for the reported reason

errors.shortDescription: Unable to get the MeshSync broker endpoint
probableCause: The broker referenced by the MeshSync spec has no resolvable endpoint
suggestedRemediation: Verify the native broker CR or the custom broker URL configured in the MeshSync spec

errors.shortDescription: Unable to clean up obsolete Broker resources
probableCause: The operator could not inspect or delete obsolete broker workloads and services during an upgrade
suggestedRemediation: Inspect the Broker Cleanup condition and operator logs, and confirm RBAC permits listing MeshSync deployments and deleting broker StatefulSets and Services

errors.shortDescription: Invalid conversion hub object
probableCause: The conversion webhook received a nil or unexpected hub object type
suggestedRemediation: Check the conversion webhook configuration and the CRD versions in use

errors.shortDescription: Invalid MeshSync ServiceAccount name
probableCause: The MESHSYNC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT environment variable on the meshery-operator Deployment is not a valid Kubernetes ServiceAccount name (a DNS-1123 subdomain)
suggestedRemediation: Set MESHSYNC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT to the ServiceAccount MeshSync should run under (meshery-meshsync for the meshery-operator chart and config/default), or unset it to use the operator's own ServiceAccount
